title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
告别秦爷爷后，林枫来到了一条小河边，熟练的吹起了口哨声。不多会儿，一只全身棕灰色，身上鳞片有些破烂的丑丑鱼露出水面。林枫轻车熟路的拿出一枚水系能量方块，然后扔到了水中。丑丑鱼也适时的一口吞下。【恭喜宿主让丑丑鱼的愉悦值从10%提升到40%，奖励金坷垃十袋，神奇糖果一枚，生命果（可以永久提升宝可梦在HP方面的个体值）】奖励一模一样。林枫也不在乎，只是摸了摸丑丑鱼的头，“丑丑鱼，要跟我一起回家嘛？”这只丑丑鱼是春分时节，下了一场大雨后，林枫在一处泥潭中发现的，当时他捡回去，养了一会儿后，因为学业的原因，便只能暂时将它放回河里面了。后面他又发现，这只丑丑鱼似乎能感知到他的气息。每每他来到河边的时候，都能看见这只丑丑鱼跟在身边。现在既然想着不去大学了，那就把它带回培育屋吧。给自己的培育屋增添一分生机。噗通！丑丑鱼在听到这句话后，愣了一下，随即有些呆滞的鱼目不可思议的看着林枫，好似在问真的吗？两者相处有一段时间了，说话的意思和含义，大概都了解一些。何况，现在的林枫还有了常磐之力。“当然。”林枫露出了笑容，并且从腰间拿出了一枚精灵球。并且打开了探查之眼。【精灵：丑丑鱼】【性别：雌】【特性：适应力】【资质：绿色】【个体值：HP（25）攻击（13）特攻（11）防御（14）特防（16）速度（10）】【实力：6~9级】【技能：跃起，撞击】【介绍：一只普普通通，但具有灵性的丑丑鱼。】【亲密度：85】【愉悦值：95】

【恭喜宿主让丑丑鱼的愉悦值从40%提升到95%，资质提升能量方块配方x1。完美级美丽鳞片，神奇糖果x10。】“嗯？”林枫眼睛一亮，看着呆滞鱼目中露出的不可抑制的欢喜，不由得轻轻点了一下它的头，“你还真是容易满足呀！”仅仅是说要带它回家，就让其愉悦值从40%升到了95%。如果非要说这个点的愉悦值怎么形容的话，那就是大脑一片空白，无法自拔的快感了。将资质能量方块的配方看了一眼后，林枫更加觉得有意思了，“运气不错，这两都是适合你的。”随后不再废话，将丑丑鱼收进精灵球。至于美丽鳞片。林枫不打算现在给丑丑鱼用。作为一名神级培育家，他自然知道什么时候给丑丑鱼用美丽鳞片最好。叮...叮...叮咚。伴随着几道红光，丑丑鱼被成功收服进入精灵球。虽说早已经过了中二的年纪，但此刻收服第一只宝可梦，林枫也不由得有些难言的激动，左右瞧了瞧，发现没人后，举起精灵球，摆出一个标准的比耶姿势，“我收服丑丑鱼了。”等回过神来后，又觉得有些好笑，赶忙将精灵球收了起来。随后顺着河流走了起来，他这次的目的不止是收服丑丑鱼，还有是引水渠的情况。以前父母还在的时候，为了取水方便，引了这条小河的水，形成渠道，直接连接到种植园。为此，还在种植园里面挖了一个蓄水的池子。他要去看看渠道的情况，等看到渠道的情况后，他松了一口气。渠道只是干涸了，里面还有些树枝，没有大碍。只要去往源头，将阻水口挖开就行了。林枫并没有第一时间去往源头，而是选择回家，去往培育屋后面的种植园。自从父母去世后，那里他就没怎么打理过了，只是偶尔桃桃树成熟的时候，回去摘一些，现在算算时间，差不多也到了桃桃果成熟的时候，

After bidding farewell to Grandpa Qin, Lin Feng came to a small river and whistled skillfully.After a while, an ugly fish with a brown-gray body and some tattered scales emerged from the water.Lin Feng took out a water energy cube with ease and threw it into the water.The ugly fish also swallowed it in one gulp at the right time.[Congratulations to the host for increasing the happiness value of the Ugly Fish from 10% to 40%. The reward is ten bags of golden garbage, a magic candy, and a life fruit (which can permanently increase the Pokémon's individual HP value)] The rewards are exactly the same.Lin Feng didn't care and just touched the ugly fish's head, "Ugly Fish, do you want to go home with me?" Lin Feng found this ugly fish in a quagmire after a heavy rain during the spring equinox. He picked it back up and raised it for a while, but due to academic reasons, he could only put it back into the river temporarily.Later he discovered that the ugly fish seemed to be able to sense his breath.Whenever he comes to the river, he can see this ugly fish following him.Now that I’m thinking about not going to college, let’s take it back to the nursery.Add a bit of life to your nursery.Plop!After hearing this sentence, Chou Chou Fish was stunned for a moment, and then looked at Lin Feng with some dull fish eyes in disbelief, as if asking is it true?The two have been getting along for a while, and they probably have some understanding of the meaning and meaning of what they say.What's more, Lin Feng now still has the power of Changpan."Of course." Lin Feng smiled and took out an elf ball from his waist.And opened the eyes of exploration.[Elf: Ugly Fish] [Gender: Female] [Characteristics: Adaptability] [Qualification: Green] [Individual Value: HP (25) Attack (13) Special Attack (11) Defense (14) Special Defense (16) Speed ​​(10)] [Strength: Level 6~9] [Skills: Jump, Impact] [Introduction: An ordinary but spiritual Ugly Fish.】【Intimacy: 85】【Pleasure value: 95】

[Congratulations to the host for increasing the happiness value of the ugly fish from 40% to 95%. The energy cube formula for improving qualifications x1.Perfect level beautiful scales, magical candy x10.] "Huh?" Lin Feng's eyes lit up, and he looked at the uncontrollable joy in the dull fish eyes. He couldn't help but nodded its head gently, "You are really easy to satisfy!" Just saying that he wanted to take it home made its happiness value rise from 40% to 95%.If I had to describe the pleasure value at this point, it would be the feeling of being completely blank and unable to extricate myself.After taking a look at the formula of the qualification energy cube, Lin Feng found it even more interesting. "You're lucky, both of these are suitable for you." Then he stopped talking nonsense and put the ugly fish into the elf ball.As for the beautiful scales.Lin Feng doesn't plan to use it for Chou Chou Fish now.As a god-level breeder, he naturally knows when is the best time to use beautiful scales on the ugly fish.Ding...ding...ding dong.Along with a few red lights, the ugly fish was successfully subdued into the elf ball.Although he was already past the age of second grade, Lin Feng couldn't help but feel a little unspeakably excited after he had subdued his first Pokémon. He looked around and found no one, then raised the elf ball and assumed a standard Biye posture, "I have subdued the Ugly Fish." After coming back to his senses, he felt a little funny again and hurriedly put the elf ball away.Then he walked along the river. His purpose this time was not only to conquer the ugly fish, but also to check the condition of the aqueduct.When my parents were still alive, in order to facilitate water collection, water from this creek was diverted to form a channel and directly connected to the plantation.For this purpose, a water storage pond was dug in the plantation.He was going to check the situation of the channel. When he saw the situation of the channel, he breathed a sigh of relief.The channel is just dry, there are still some branches in it, nothing serious.Just go to the source and dig out the water blockage.Lin Feng did not go to the source immediately, but chose to go home to the plantation behind the cultivation house.Since his parents passed away, he hasn't taken care of it much. He only occasionally goes back to pick some peach trees when they are ripe. Now that he counts the time, it is almost the time when the peach trees are ripe.
